subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Toyota Corolla
description: A quick win: understand The Toyota Corolla.

hook.text: The Toyota Corolla is the best-selling car nameplate of all time—over 50 million and counting.

buildup.text: Launched in 1966, it offered basic reliable transportation. Nothing flashy, nothing broken.

discovery.text: Toyota updated it every few years, always improving quality without raising the price dramatically.

twist.text: No one loves a Corolla passionately—but millions trust it completely. Boring became its superpower.

climax.text: It's sold in over 150 countries. For many people worldwide, Corolla is their first car.

punchline.text: The world's best-selling car was never the most exciting.

quiz.question: How many Toyota Corollas have been sold worldwide?

details.summary: The Toyota Corolla is the best-selling car nameplate in history with over 50 million units sold since 1966, offering reliable and affordable transportation to families on every continent.
details.whyItMatters: The Corolla represents transportation as appliance: dependable, affordable, and universally available. Its longevity demonstrates the immense value of reliability and sensible engineering over flash.
takeaways: Over 50 million Corollas have been sold across 12 generations
It has been manufactured on every continent except Antarctica
The name means crown of flowers in Latin

faq.question: Why has the Corolla outsold every other car in history?
faq.answer: It combines Toyota reliability with affordable pricing and practical design in a package that works for diverse markets worldwide. Each generation refines the formula without alienating existing loyal buyers.

faq.question: Is the Corolla exciting to drive?
faq.answer: It prioritizes comfort and efficiency over excitement. Recent generations have improved handling and added a sport-tuned GR Corolla variant, but the core appeal remains sensible, trouble-free transportation.
